CopySprig notes

Contact CopySprig

For a bug report, a missing symbol or a privacy question, use the CopySprig project contact channel. Please do not include private text or account details in a public report.

A useful bug report

Include the page, your browser and what happened. A short non-sensitive example is enough. Tell us whether copying failed, a glyph displayed as a box or a result differed from the original text.

Suggesting a symbol

Share the character and its Unicode name if known. We prioritize useful compact additions with clear labels over large duplicated collections.
